input.command:
while true; do
  # Check if tmux session still exists
  ssh autodl-5090 "tmux has-session -t indep_seed 2>/dev/null" || { echo "PIPELINE_ENDED: tmux session gone"; break; }
  
  # Get current line count for both files
  pythia_lines=$(ssh autodl-5090 "wc -l < /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/independent_seed/pythia-2.8b-indepA/generations_shard0.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0")
  olmo_lines=$(ssh autodl-5090 "wc -l < /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/independent_seed/olmo-2-1b-indepB/generations_shard0.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0")
  
  # Check for results file (means evaluation is done)
  results=$(ssh autodl-5090 "cat /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results/independent_seed_results.json 2>/dev/null || echo ''")
  if [ -n "$results" ]; then
    echo "EVALUATION_COMPLETE: $results"
    break
  fi
  
  # Check for errors in log
  errors=$(ssh autodl-5090 "grep -c 'Traceback\|Error\|FAILED\|OOM\|Killed' /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/logs/indep_seed.log 2>/dev/null || echo 0")
  
  pythia_seeds=$((pythia_lines / 5))
  olmo_seeds=$((olmo_lines / 5))
  
  echo "PROGRESS: Pythia=${pythia_seeds}/500 seeds (${pythia_lines} records), OLMo=${olmo_seeds}/500 seeds (${olmo_lines} records), errors=${errors}"
  
  # Check for feature extraction progress
  feat_pythia=$(ssh autodl-5090 "ls -la /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/features_indep_pythia-2.8b.csv 2>/dev/null || echo 'not_started'")
  feat_olmo=$(ssh autodl-5090 "ls -la /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/features_indep_olmo-2-1b.csv 2>/dev/null || echo 'not_started'")
  if echo "$feat_pythia" | grep -q "csv"; then
    echo "FEATURE_STATUS: Pythia features exist"
  fi
  if echo "$feat_olmo" | grep -q "csv"; then
    echo "FEATURE_STATUS: OLMo features exist"
  fi
  
  sleep 300
done
